title: Imperial orders are like mountains
next_chapter_hook: On the city wall, a bamboo slip carved with the Chen family's old emblem lay quietly between the tiles—in three days, the complete map of the Tianqing Sect's secret passage would arrive as promised. Su Qingyao's trust had finally bridged three years of trials and pursuit.

text.content: At midnight, candlelight flickered in the Grand Tutor's study. Chen Ji placed the encrypted secret report on the candlestick; flames licked the silk's edge, revealing tiny characters: the Xuanwu Sect's true target was the Grand Tutor's residence in the imperial capital, not the Tianqing Sect. A slight smile curved his lips as he tossed the report into the charcoal brazier, watching it turn to ash. Those fools of Xuanwu Sect thought their intricate scheme was flawless, but they never realized the true chessboard had long been in his hands.

A black-clad assassin materialized silently outside the door, kneeling on one knee. Chen Ji drew three golden tokens from his sleeve, issuing orders one by one: First, order General Han Biao of the Northern Defense to immediately lead three thousand elite cavalry south, setting an ambush at the Qingzhou Pass—upon encountering any Xuanwu Sect convoy, detain them first regardless of circumstances. Second, convey to His Highness the Crown Prince that tonight's memorial has been drafted; tomorrow morning court, please present the 'Border Army Reassignment' memorial. Third—he paused, a ruthless glint flickering in his eyes—let those associated with the Second Prince know that tonight's visitor to the Grand Tutor's residence is of extraordinary status.

The assassin took the golden tokens and vanished into the night like a shadow. Chen Ji stood with hands clasped behind his back at the window, gazing at the scattered lights toward the imperial city. The Tianji Record in his chest felt faintly warm. He knew that every layout rewriting fate consumed his precious Heavenly Fate. But this game, he had to win. The fools of Xuanwu Sect wanted to assassinate him under the pretense of 'punishing Tianqing'—so he would have the border army seal their retreat routes under the name of 'escorting the emperor.'

dialogue.content: In the end, the chess game of this world must be broken by open, righteous schemes.

text.content: The next morning, in the golden hall of the imperial city, all officials stood solemnly. The Crown Prince presented the 'Border Army Reassignment' memorial as planned, with earnest wording and sufficient reasons—Northern Barbarians were stirring, and border army reassignment was precaution against potential disaster. The Minister of Revenue from the Second Prince's faction furrowed his brows, about to step forward and refute, when the Grand Tutor's attendant had already stealthily handed him a secret letter. Upon unfolding it, his face turned deathly pale.

dialogue.content: (The Minister of Revenue was terrified: How does this Grand Tutor know about my secretly embezzling military funds? And the evidence is so detailed!)

text.content: The morning court concluded in an eerie silence. Not a single person from the Second Prince's faction opposed; the imperial decree for border army reassignment passed smoothly. That afternoon, three thousand Northern Defense elite cavalry broke camp and marched urgently south toward Qingzhou Pass. When news reached the Xuanwu Sect's main camp, Han Lie was drinking celebratory wine in high spirits.

choice.prompt: The Xuanwu Sect's vanguard had entered Qingzhou territory. Chen Ji needed to make a decision: strike first to detain them preemptively, or let them go to catch the bigger fish when the main force takes the bait?

choices.description: Immediately order the Northern Defense Army to detain the Xuanwu Sect vanguard—startling the snake, but establishing prestige
choices.visible_cost: Reveal strength; the Xuanwu Sect main force may retreat
choices.visible_reward: Significant deterrent effect; the Second Prince's faction will become even more wary
choices.risk_hint: May startle the snake, alerting the Xuanwu Sect main force

text.content: The Northern Defense Army's iron cavalry appeared at the pass like dark clouds pressing down. The Xuanwu Sect vanguard was caught off guard, over a hundred men instantly surrounded. Upon hearing the news at the main camp, Han Lie flew into a rage, shattering his wine cup—the useless Grand Tutor actually dared to strike first!

choices.text: Let them go to catch a bigger fish
choices.description: Let the vanguard pass through; wait specifically for the Xuanwu Sect main force to step into the trap, eliminating them all at once
choices.visible_cost: The vanguard may pass along information; must ensure the main force remains unaware
choices.visible_reward: If successful, can completely reverse the situation and gain fame throughout the realm
choices.risk_hint: If news leaks, all efforts may come to naught

text.content: The vanguard passed smoothly through the pass, proceeding unimpeded toward the imperial capital. Han Lie sneered: As expected of a useless Grand Tutor, even the border army doesn't dare act resolutely. He had no idea that death's invitation had already been laid out ahead, waiting for him to walk into the trap.

choices.text: Quietly observe and wait for changes
choices.description: First observe how the Crown Prince's faction and Second Prince's faction react, using this opportunity to probe the bottom lines of all parties
choices.visible_cost: May miss the best opportunity to strike
choices.visible_reward: Striking after seeing the situation clearly gives higher odds of victory
choices.risk_hint: Various forces may take the opportunity to set up their schemes

text.content: The situation in the imperial capital suddenly became tense. The Crown Prince faction and the Second Prince's forces openly confronted each other over the border army reshuffle, with impeachment memorials against the Grand Tutor flying to the emperor like snowflakes. Chen Ji sat calmly in the Grand Tutor's mansion, turning a deaf ear to all of this—what he was waiting for was precisely this chaos.

While undercurrents surged among various factions, a slender figure stood quietly in the dark alley outside the Grand Tutor's mansion. Su Qingyao, dressed in plain-colored combat attire with a thin veil over her face, finally stopped her three-year-long search. She gazed at the heavily guarded residence, complex light flickering in her eyes—thetrash杂役 from back then had now become the Crown Prince's Grand Tutor, second only to one person under heaven.

dialogue.content: (She thought to herself: Three years have passed. I've approached the truth countless times, only to have him deflect me each time. This time, I won't give him another chance.)

text.content: However, just as she prepared to reveal herself, a death warrior emerged from the Grand Tutor's mansion, carrying a brocade box in his hands. The death warrior walked straight toward the dark alley where she was hiding, knelt on one knee, and raised the box high above his head.

dialogue.content: Junior Sister Su, long time no see. The item in the box is the truth I promised to investigate for you three years ago—the full account of the Tianqing Sect's annihilation.

text.content: Su Qingyao shuddered throughout her body. Three years ago, she had entrusted Chen Ji to secretly investigate that bloodbath, though she hadn't believed he could uncover anything at the time. Now the truth had indeed been exposed, and the one who had uncovered it was precisely the target she had been pursuing all along. She slowly opened the brocade box, a yellowed scroll resting quietly inside, bearing the unmistakable words: Written by Ling Yuan.

choice.prompt: Su Qingyao finally revealed herself, and the truth surfaced. Chen Ji needed to decide how to handle this complex relationship: to draw her into the chess game, or maintain a superficial distance?

choices.description: Show Su Qingyao part of the Tianji Record's abilities and formally invite her to become an ally
choices.visible_cost: Exposing the existence of the Tianji Record may bring greater dangers
choices.visible_reward: Gain a powerful ally, Su Qingyao's favorability increases significantly
choices.risk_hint: The Tianji Record's aura may be detected by the Eyes of Heavenly Dao

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao took the scroll, her fingertips trembling slightly. When she read the words 'Ling Yuan colluded with the Demonic Path and used others as a blade,' a cold light suddenly flashed in her eyes. After a moment, she tucked the scroll into her chest, looked up and stared directly at Chen Ji: What are your terms?

choices.description: Maintain distance, only provide partial information, to test Su Qingyao's true intentions
choices.visible_cost: May miss the opportunity to form an alliance, Su Qingyao may leave
choices.visible_reward: Maintain an air of mystery while observing her stance

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao remained silent for a long while, tucked the scroll into her chest, but did not leave. She gazed at Chen Ji, her voice cold and clear: Chen Ji, exactly who are you? I've investigated for three years yet can't even grasp the corner of your robe.

choices.description: Warn Su Qingyao not to interfere in this matter and forcibly expel her from the Grand Tutor's mansion grounds
choices.visible_cost: Lose a potential ally, Su Qingyao's favorability plummets
choices.visible_reward: Protect the secret of the Tianji Record, reduce variables
choices.risk_hint: Su Qingyao may become a potential threat

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao was driven out of the dark alley, standing at the end of the long street, looking back at the Grand Tutor's residence. She clenched her fists, her knuckles turning white. Chen Ji... You think this can get rid of me? Three years ago when you saved me, I told you—you owe me the truth.

text.content: Just as the capital was in turmoil, thunderous news arrived from the north—the Xuanwu Sect's main force of thirty thousand troops, under the pretext of 'eradicating demonic path remnants,' had crossed Qingzhou and advanced toward the capital! Han Lie personally led the vanguard, bristling with menace, declaring his intention to purge treacherous ministers. The court was shaken, and the Second Prince's faction seized the opportunity to impeach the Grand Tutor for 'waging reckless wars' and 'provoking a sect war.'

dialogue.content: (The Eye of Heavenly Dao trembles slightly in the Void, as if observing all of this. It sensed that familiar aura—the chess piece bearing the Tianji Record was finally beginning to rise.)

text.content: Yet Chen Ji smiled. He unfolded the Tianji Record Fragment, and images of the next three hours appeared—one by one. The Xuanwu Sect's main force would be ambushed at a place called Luoyan Slope, and the commanding officer was his secretly placed chess piece: the Shadow Guard Leader serving under the Crown Prince. And Han Lie, at this very moment, was walking proudly at the forefront, completely unaware of the death approaching him.

He closed the fragment, a cold light flickering in his eyes. The fools of the Xuanwu Sect thought their diversion tactics could deceive him. Little did they know, he had foreseen this very day a month ago—every foresight from the Tianji Record consumed his Heavenly Fate. But this game, he had to win.

choice.prompt: The Xuanwu Sect's main force was already in the trap, and Chen Ji needed to decide how to close the net: should he have the Crown Prince's Shadow Guards directly annihilate them, or deliberately let some escape to create greater panic and intimidate the Second Prince?

choices.description: Order the Crown Prince's Shadow Guards to completely annihilate the Xuanwu Sect's main force at Luoyan Slope, deciding the outcome in a single battle
choices.visible_cost: May intensify contradictions between sects and the dynasty
choices.visible_reward: The Xuanwu Sect suffers heavy losses, Han Lie dies, reputation reaches its pinnacle
choices.risk_hint: May provoke other sects to unite in retaliation

text.content: On Luoyan Slope, the Crown Prince's Shadow Guards descended like divine soldiers. The Xuanwu Sect's main force was caught off guard, defeated and scattered. Han Lie was surrounded, fighting to exhaustion, and ultimately captured alive. When news reached the capital, all court officials were stunned—the Grand Tutor deemed worthless actually possessed such means!

choices.description: Release part of the Xuanwu Sect's remnant soldiers, letting them带回fearful to the sect, creating greater deterrent effect
choices.visible_cost: The Xuanwu Sect may return for revenge
choices.visible_reward: Terror is more powerful than killing, the Second Prince's faction will be completely intimidated
choices.risk_hint: Releasing a tiger back to the mountains brings endless future troubles

text.content: The setting sun glowed like blood, corpses littered Luoyan Slope. The Crown Prince's Shadow Guards deliberately opened an escape route, and dozens of remnant soldiers escaped with their lives. They scrambled toward the direction of Xuanwu Sect, telling everyone they met: the army of the Grand Tutor's residence came from hell! Fear spread like a plague through Xuanwu Sect.

choices.description: Show mercy but capture Han Lie alive, using him to coerce Xuanwu Sect for greater benefits
choices.visible_cost: Need to divide forces to guard prisoners
choices.visible_reward: Holding the Xuanwu Sect's number one genius, can exchange for countless bargaining chips
choices.risk_hint: Han Lie may be rescued by others

text.content: When Han Lie was dragged to the Grand Tutor's Residence bound with ropes, the face that once showed unbridled arrogance was now full of humiliation and resentment. Chen Ji looked down at him from above and said indifferently: 'Han Genius, do you still remember how you humiliated me on the Martial Arena all those years ago?'

On the same night Han Lie was thrown into the prison, a special visitor arrived at the Grand Tutor's Residence. Su Qingyao did not choose to leave; instead, she had been observing from the shadows for an entire day. When she saw the chess game Chen Ji had laid out with thunderous手段, the last trace of doubt in her heart finally dissipated. This man was far more terrifying than she had imagined—and far more worthy of following.

She quietly left a bamboo slip engraved with the old Chen Family emblem on the city wall. Inside the bamboo slip was the complete map of Tianqing Sect's secret passages that she had collected over three years of traveling the world—this was the greatest sincerity she could offer Chen Ji, and also proof of her choice to trust him. Three days later, this map would appear on the desk of the Grand Tutor's Residence. And she would formally become a key piece in Chen Ji's chess game.

dialogue.content: (She silently said in her heart: Chen Ji, this round, I'm betting on you to win.)

text.content: The imperial capital was deep in night, with scattered lights. Chen Ji stood alone by the window, gazing at the waning moon in the sky. The Tianji Record in his arms was slightly scorching, as if warning him—every layout that rewrites destiny is pushing him toward a deeper abyss. But at this moment, his eyes held only absolute calm. Ling Yuan, Xuanwu Sect, the Second Prince, the Eyes of Heavenly Dao... all enemies would eventually be ground to dust in his chess game. And Su Qingyao's addition made this game even more magnificent.

Just then, a carrier pigeon landed on the windowsill. Chen Ji removed the thin tube tied to the pigeon's leg and unfolded the note inside. It contained only eight characters: 'Heavenly Secrets initially revealed, the imperial decree is like a mountain.' He smiled faintly and reduced the note to ashes. The chess game has begun, and there is no regret in placing pieces. And the true storm has just begun...
